text.description: The words of the user. May be empty (since 1.11) when `images` has an image: she then looks at it with no words.

stream.description: Answer as server-sent events (default false); Accept: text/event-stream does the same.

reasoning.description: Include the thinking of the model (default false).

node.description: The node the words came from.

images.description: Images to look at with the words (since 1.11): the ids `POST /api/v1/jois/{id}/images` gave, in this order, at most 4. 409 `no_vision` when she cannot look at images.
